notes: Conditional on the generated equations being semi-regular. A=1 gives the paper’s rounded time exponent (2.35ω+1.13)n and rounded memory exponent 5.85n. These are historical algebraic bounds, not best overall LWE exponents.

extra.parameters: Prime q(n) sufficiently large for degree n/A; error σ=√n/√(2π); A≥1 fixed; C_A is the degree-of-regularity constant from Lemma 6 / Proposition 3; C_1≈1.41.
extra.noise: Discrete Gaussian with standard deviation σ=√n/√(2π), hence width αq=√n.
extra.model: Field operations; ω is the chosen dense linear-algebra exponent; H₂ is binary entropy.
extra.assumptions: Assumption 1: semi-regularity of the generated high-degree LWE equations.
extra.success: At least 1−2/(π√n), conditional on the stated algebraic assumption.
